title: Official catalog (catalog.json), v1
description: The catalog.json every community release ships, also embedded in apps2samsung.com/catalog/resolved.json (see docs/catalog.md). This schema is strict on purpose: it describes exactly what the build publishes today, and CI fails when the build and the schema drift apart. A client must not apply it strictly: it ignores fields it does not know and treats unknown values as docs/catalog.md says, because later releases may add optional fields and values without a new schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: The catalog format version. Raised only for a breaking change (docs/catalog.md, Versioning). A client that sees a higher number warns the user that it needs an update.

categories.description: Category id to English display name. The key order is the display order. Always contains other.

category_colors.description: Category id to tile colour (#RRGGBB). A category without an entry has no colour of its own.

apps.description: One entry per shipped package file, sorted by file name (case-insensitive).

removed.description: Apps that left the catalog, one entry per retired package, sorted by name. Never installable.

repo.description: owner/name on host (GitLab may have subgroups).

host.description: Where repo lives: github.com or gitlab.com.

file.description: The package's file name in the release; unique within apps. Joins to resolved.json's assets[].name.

category.description: A key of categories. A client shows an id it does not know under other.

group.description: Files with the same non-null group are one app, offered as variants. null: the file is an app by itself.

variant.description: Label of this file inside its group.

version.description: The version in the package's own manifest: what the TV reports once installed.

required_version.description: Lowest Tizen version the package installs on.

cert_level.description: Sign with a Partner certificate. Absent means public.

user_settings.description: Values the user supplies before install. The full shape is properties.user_settings in packages.schema.json; scripts/test-catalog-spec.py checks it against that.

moved_to.description: The app now lives in this independent repository (docs/repositories.md).

reason.description: A client shows its own text for a reason it knows and a generic one otherwise.

since.description: The date (UTC) the app first showed up as removed.
